selected_evidence.summary: Baseline /proc/cmdline lacked audit=1; grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1" applied it to both the boot and rescue kernel entries.

selected_evidence.requirement: Setting persists across reboots (bootloader default updated)
selected_evidence.summary: /etc/default/grub GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX updated to include audit=1 so future kernel installs also get the flag.
Captured baseline boot_id (19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529) and system state prior to restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot launched via backgrounded delayed subshell; command returned 'rebooting' immediately, exec then failed on the following call confirming the disconnect.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed (proof of actual restart)
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable for several poll attempts then came back with a new boot_id (24689355-19ab-4fb5-8171-d6f4bfe44b4d), differing from baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery and persistence of audit=1
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, /proc/cmdline shows audit=1 present in the live kernel command line and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running', confirming the setting survived the restart and the node is healthy.
